title: Beacon Recon — Find the Hidden Network
description: Given recon-lab.pcapng, enumerate APs and find hidden SSID. Guided with steps.

tasks.question: How many APs total?
tasks.hint: Filter wlan.fc.type_subtype==8, count unique BSSIDs

tasks.question: Which SSID is hidden? How revealed?
tasks.answer: HIDDEN-LAB revealed via probe response frame 10
tasks.hint: Look for SSID empty beacon then probe response with real SSID

tasks.question: Which BSSIDs share ESS LAB-WIFI?
tasks.hint: Same SSID different BSSID different channel = ESS

title: WPA2 Handshake — Evidence Collection
description: Analyze wpa2-handshake.pcapng, identify complete handshake, collect evidence for report.

tasks.question: How many EAPOL frames? Complete?
tasks.answer: 4 EAPOL, complete M1-M4
tasks.hint: Filter eapol, check replay counter

tasks.question: ANonce and SNonce (first 8 hex)?
tasks.answer: ANonce aabbccdd, SNonce 11223344
tasks.hint: Check EAPOL M1 and M2 nonce fields

tasks.question: What is needed for offline audit?
tasks.answer: SSID, BSSID, client MAC, ANonce, SNonce, MIC
tasks.hint: PMK via PBKDF2, PTK via PRF, MIC verification

title: PMKID — Clientless Capture
description: Analyze pmkid.pcapng, extract PMKID, understand clientless advantage.

tasks.question: PMKID hex?
tasks.hint: Check EAPOL M1 key data KDE with PMKID

tasks.question: Advantage vs handshake?
tasks.answer: Clientless, single frame, no deauth needed
tasks.hint: PMKID can be captured without client, no deauth

title: WPS Enumeration — PIN Risk
description: Detect WPS IE in wps-beacon.pcapng and audit config with WPS enabled.

tasks.question: WPS IE present? OUI?
tasks.answer: Yes, 00:50:F2:04, frames 1-2
tasks.hint: Filter wps or wlan_mgt.tag.number==221

tasks.question: PIN brute-force max?
tasks.hint: Halves flaw, not 10^8

tasks.question: Config fix?
tasks.answer: wps_state=0 disable WPS
tasks.hint: Disable WPS

title: WPA3 Transition — Downgrade Risk
description: Analyze wpa3-transition.pcapng and configs, identify transition mode weaknesses.

tasks.question: AKMs? PMF? Transition?
tasks.answer: PSK+SAE, PMF optional, transition yes
tasks.hint: Check RSN IE akms.type, mfpc/mfpr

tasks.question: Downgrade risk? Defense?
tasks.answer: Force WPA2 via deauth, capture handshake if PSK weak, PMF optional allows deauth. Defense: WPA3-only PMF required, strong PSK
tasks.hint: Transition same password, PMF optional allows deauth

title: Deauth Flood — PMF Detection
description: Analyze deauth.pcapng, count deauth frames, check PMF, assess impact.

tasks.question: How many deauth? Reason?
tasks.answer: 12 deauth reason 7, 1 disassoc reason 8
tasks.hint: Filter wlan.fc.type_subtype==12 and ==10

tasks.question: PMF required?
tasks.answer: No, MFPC=0 MFPR=0, PMF disabled, deauth possible
tasks.hint: Check beacon RSN capabilities mfpr

tasks.question: Impact and fix?
tasks.answer: DoS, handshake capture, Evil Twin facilitation. Fix: ieee80211w=2 PMF required, WPA3-only
tasks.hint: PMF required prevents spoofed deauth

title: Rogue AP — Evil Twin Detection
description: Analyze rogue-ap.pcapng, detect rogue BSSID cloning Corp-WLAN, assess client association.

tasks.question: BSSIDs for Corp-WLAN?
tasks.answer: 2: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF legit Ch6 and 11:22:33:44:55:66 rogue Ch11
tasks.hint: Filter wlan_mgt.ssid==Corp-WLAN, list BSSIDs

tasks.question: Which is rogue? Evidence?
tasks.answer: 11:22:33:44:55:66 Ch11 different vendor not in authorized list, same SSID different BSSID channel
tasks.hint: Channel, vendor OUI, authorized list

tasks.question: Client associated to rogue?
tasks.hint: Check assoc req/resp to rogue BSSID

title: Captive Portal — Open Network & Session Bypass
description: Analyze captive-portal.pcapng, check open network, portal redirect, session management, isolation.

tasks.question: Is it open? Evidence?
tasks.answer: Yes, open, no EAPOL, association open, beacon Open Ch6
tasks.hint: Check beacon security Open, no 4-way

tasks.question: Portal redirect? HTTPS?
tasks.answer: HTTP GET example.com -> 302 redirect to https://portal.guest.com/login, login POST over HTTP weak
tasks.hint: Filter http, check GET and redirect and POST

tasks.question: Session bypass via MAC spoof?
tasks.answer: Yes, MAC-based session, open no encryption, sniff MAC, spoof to bypass portal
tasks.hint: Open network, MAC-based firewall allows MAC after auth, sniff and spoof

title: Enterprise — PEAP Without Cert Validation
description: Analyze enterprise.pcapng, identify WPA2-EAP, PEAP without ca_cert, rogue RADIUS risk, RADIUS weak secret.

tasks.question: EAP method? Identity?
tasks.answer: PEAP-MSCHAPv2, user@corp.com
tasks.hint: Filter eap, check Identity and type 25 PEAP

tasks.question: ca_cert present? Risk?
tasks.answer: No ca_cert, Evil Twin + rogue RADIUS captures MSCHAPv2 challenge/response for hashcat -m 5500
tasks.hint: Check wpa_supplicant.conf, no ca_cert

tasks.question: RADIUS secret strength?
tasks.answer: testing123 weak, should be 22+ chars random, RadSec
tasks.hint: Check clients.conf secret

title: EAP — MSCHAPv2 Capture & Offline Crack
description: Analyze eap.pcapng with PEAP MSCHAPv2 Challenge/Response, understand offline cracking, defense EAP-TLS.

tasks.question: What EAP method? Identity? Challenge/Response?
tasks.answer: PEAP-MSCHAPv2, user@corp.com, Challenge/Response captured inside TLS if no cert validation
tasks.hint: Filter eap, check Identity, type 25, MSCHAPv2

tasks.question: Can you crack offline? Tool and mode?
tasks.answer: Yes, hashcat -m 5500 NetNTLMv1/MSCHAPv2 or asleap, if password weak
tasks.hint: MSCHAPv2 challenge/response -> NTLM hash crackable

tasks.question: Defense?
tasks.answer: Enforce ca_cert + subject_match via MDM/GPO, prefer EAP-TLS mutual cert, strong RADIUS secret, PMF, WIDS
tasks.hint: Cert validation + EAP-TLS

title: RADIUS — Weak Secret & No RadSec
description: Audit FreeRADIUS clients.conf secret testing123 weak, users weak password, no RadSec, logs no monitoring.

tasks.question: RADIUS secret? Strength?
tasks.answer: testing123 weak, should be 22+ chars random, per NAS unique
tasks.hint: Check clients.conf secret

tasks.question: Users? VLAN? Password strength?
tasks.answer: user1 WeakPass, VLAN 100, weak, no complexity lockout
tasks.hint: Check users file

tasks.question: RadSec enabled? Logs monitored?
tasks.answer: No RadSec UDP not encrypted, no monitoring, should use RadSec TLS + SIEM
tasks.hint: Check radiusd.conf, logs

title: Corporate Attacks — Rogue + Segmentation + Isolation Bypass
description: Analyze corporate-attacks.pcapng: 3 SSIDs Enterprise/Guest/IoT + rogue + deauth + segmentation bypass + isolation bypass.

tasks.question: How many SSIDs? BSSIDs? Rogue?
tasks.answer: 3 SSIDs: Corp-Enterprise EAP Ch6 AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF, Corp-Guest Open Ch11 BB:CC:DD:EE:FF:00, IoT-PSK WPS Ch1 CC:DD:EE:FF:00:11 + rogue 11:22:33:44:55:66 clones Enterprise Ch11
tasks.hint: Filter wlan.fc.type_subtype==8, list SSIDs BSSIDs channels security

tasks.question: Credential capture? EAP method? Identity?
tasks.answer: Yes, PEAP-MSCHAPv2, user@corp.com, Challenge/Response captured by rogue RADIUS 11:22:33:44:55:66
tasks.hint: Filter eap, check Identity, MSCHAPv2 Challenge/Response

tasks.question: Segmentation bypass? Isolation bypass? Defense?
tasks.answer: Corp VLAN 100 to Guest VLAN 200 ping success ACL misconfigured, Guest ap_isolate=0 ARP spoof possible. Defense: WIDS authorized list + 802.1X cert validation + EAP-TLS + strong secret + RadSec + PMF + VLAN ACL deny + ap_isolate=1 + monitoring
tasks.hint: Check Data frames ICMP ping Corp→Guest success, ARP Guest
